description: Use this to inspect what an XDaLa session actually did. Returns decoded engine receipt data such as input payload, API saves, contract saves, execution contract, rule contract, valid flag, inner gas usage and optional raw receipt logs. Do not use this for a simple transaction timeline; use get_session_transactions instead.

includeBlock.description: Value for the include block parameter.

includeRaw.description: Value for the include raw parameter.

includeTx.description: Value for the include tx parameter.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

owner.description: EVM address of the XDaLa session owner or relevant account.

sessionId.description: XDaLa session identifier used to query runtime or explorer data.

stepIds.description: Value for the step ids parameter.

name: get_session_receipt_logs

data.description: Structured result data returned by the XGR MCP gateway.

title: Get XDaLa session receipt logs
